$comment: Optional external services (MCP servers and APIs) that generate assets for a film: voice, music, sound effects, images, video. Nothing here is installed, bundled or required. The user connects a service in their own agent with their own account or key; FCWM only documents how and checks whether it is connected. tier: free | restricted | paid (paid = billed to the user's account). kind: mcp-remote (hosted URL) | mcp-local (runs on the user's machine) | api (plain HTTP API, key in an environment variable). auth: oauth | api-key | cloud-credentials. status: listed (setup documented from the vendor's docs, not run end to end by FCWM) | tested (connected and one generation run by FCWM) | deprecated (upstream archived or replaced; kept so old setups are recognised). 'checked' is the date licence, stars and activity were last verified.

services.name: ElevenLabs (hosted MCP)
services.purpose: Speech and voice-over, voice design, sound effects, music, transcription; the hosted server also exposes image and video models.
services.pricing_note: Credits on the user's ElevenLabs plan; a free plan with monthly credits exists.

services.name: ElevenLabs MCP (local, archived)
services.purpose: Older local server for speech, voice cloning, sound effects and transcription.
services.pricing_note: Same credits as the hosted server.
services.notes: Repository archived (1.5k stars, last push 2026-08-20); upstream points to the hosted server. Prefer the hosted entry.

services.name: fal (hosted MCP)
services.purpose: Search, price and run hundreds of image, video, audio, voice and music models.
services.pricing_note: The server is free; each model run is billed at fal's per-model price. The server can report prices before a run.

services.name: Replicate (hosted or local MCP)
services.purpose: Discover, compare and run thousands of community and official models (image, video, audio).
services.pricing_note: Billed per second of compute or per output, depending on the model.
services.license: Apache-2.0 (local npm package replicate-mcp, 0.9.0, updated 2025-12-18); hosted server proprietary
services.notes: The hosted server asks for the API token in a browser sign-in page, so the token never goes into a config file.

services.name: Runway (hosted MCP)
services.purpose: Video generation and editing, images, music, speech and sound effects.
services.pricing_note: Uses credits on the user's Runway plan.
services.license: Proprietary hosted service (wrapper plugin runwayml/runway-mcp-plugin is MIT)

services.name: MiniMax MCP (local)
services.purpose: Text to speech, voice cloning and design, video (Hailuo) and image generation.
services.pricing_note: Pay as you go on the user's MiniMax account. Key and host must be from the same region.
services.notes: 1.6k stars, last push 2026-08-20. Upstream now recommends its CLI (mmx-cli) for the newest models.

services.name: Google GenMedia MCP servers (local, experimental)
services.purpose: Veo video, Gemini (Nano Banana) images, Lyria music, Gemini TTS and Chirp speech, plus an AVTool server for FFmpeg compositing, on Vertex AI.
services.pricing_note: Billed to the user's Google Cloud project at Vertex AI prices.
services.notes: Official Google Cloud code in the repository's experiments folder (1.2k stars, last push 2026-10-31). One server per capability (for example mcp-veo-go, mcp-nanobanana-go). Needs gcloud application-default credentials.
